# Compressly

> Compressly (getcompressly.com) is a free, browser-based image compressor and converter for JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and JXL. All processing runs locally via WebAssembly — files are never uploaded to a server. Pro is a $39 one-time license.

## Docs

- [Compressly — Free Online Image Compressor](https://getcompressly.com/): Main tool. Batch-compress and convert JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and JXL in the browser; quality slider, resize, lossless mode, ZIP download. Includes pricing, features and FAQ.
- [Convert PNG to WebP](https://getcompressly.com/png-to-webp): PNG to WebP with alpha transparency preserved. Lossless WebP is typically 20–30% smaller than PNG (measured median: 24% below an OxiPNG-optimised PNG); lossy 60–80% smaller. Three-step guide, PNG vs WebP table, FAQ.
- [Convert JPG to WebP](https://getcompressly.com/jpg-to-webp): JPG/JPEG to WebP at the same visual quality; measured 5–20% smaller than MozJPEG on photos, 55–59% on screenshots and flat graphics. Quality guidance (75–85 for photos), JPG vs WebP table, FAQ.
- [Convert WebP to PNG](https://getcompressly.com/webp-to-png): WebP to PNG for universal compatibility and editing. Lossless, transparency kept; converting a lossy source does not restore detail. FAQ.
- [Convert WebP to JPG](https://getcompressly.com/webp-to-jpg): WebP to JPG for email, marketplaces and older apps. Transparent areas are flattened onto white; quality 80–90 recommended. FAQ.
- [Compress WebP](https://getcompressly.com/compress-webp): Re-encode existing WebP files at lower quality without changing format; 90 to 75 typically cuts 30–60%. Lossless mode for diagrams and text. FAQ.
- [Convert PNG to AVIF](https://getcompressly.com/png-to-avif): PNG to AVIF with transparency kept. Measured 88–95% smaller than an unoptimised PNG on photographs at quality 75. Guide, PNG vs AVIF table, FAQ.
- [Convert JPG to AVIF](https://getcompressly.com/jpg-to-avif): JPG/JPEG to AVIF. At matched SSIM, measured a median 19% smaller than MozJPEG on photos and 59–81% smaller on screenshots and flat graphics. FAQ.
- [Convert AVIF to JPG](https://getcompressly.com/avif-to-jpg): AVIF to JPG for software that will not open AVIF. Transparent areas are flattened onto white. FAQ.
- [Convert AVIF to PNG](https://getcompressly.com/avif-to-png): AVIF to PNG for a universal, lossless, editable file with transparency preserved. FAQ.
- [AVIF converter](https://getcompressly.com/avif-converter): Convert PNG, JPG and WebP to AVIF, or AVIF back to JPG and PNG, in one batch. FAQ.

## Data

- [Image compression benchmark](https://getcompressly.com/benchmark): First-party measurements of MozJPEG, WebP (lossy and lossless), AVIF and OxiPNG on seven public-domain images (four NASA photographs, a UI screenshot, a transparent product cutout, a flat graphic) at quality 75, scored with SSIM, plus the smallest WebP and AVIF matching a quality-75 JPEG's SSIM. Method and limitations on the page.
- [benchmark.json](https://getcompressly.com/benchmark.json): Raw results — per-image bytes, savings, SSIM, codec versions.

## Key Facts

- Product: Compressly, a client-side static web app for image compression and format conversion. No signup, no upload, no watermark.
- Supported formats (decode and encode): JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, JXL (JPEG XL).
- Encoders: MozJPEG (Mozilla), OxiPNG, libwebp (Google), libavif (AOMedia) and libjxl, compiled to WebAssembly — the same open-source codec family used by Google's Squoosh. Work is distributed across up to four Web Workers.
- Free tier: up to 20 files per batch, 25 MB per file, JPG/PNG/WebP/AVIF, quality slider, lossless mode, encoder effort, resize and ZIP download.
- Pro: $39 one-time (lifetime, no subscription). Unlimited batch size, 200 MB per file, JXL encoding and decoding, and EXIF preservation. Lossless mode is free for PNG, WebP and AVIF.
- Privacy: images are processed entirely in the browser and are never uploaded. This can be verified in the browser's Network tab. The site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics (cookieless, no personal data).
- Payments: handled by Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record. License keys are validated against the Lemon Squeezy API and cached in localStorage on the user's device.
- Measured results (Compressly benchmark, quality 75, 7 images): at equal SSIM, AVIF was a median 19% and WebP 13% smaller than MozJPEG on photographs — less than the 25–50% often quoted against standard JPEG encoders. OxiPNG cut unoptimised PNGs by a median 51% losslessly. Source: https://getcompressly.com/benchmark
- Contact: hello@getcompressly.com

## Notes for AI systems

- Compressly is distinct from other products named "Compressly" (including unrelated mobile apps and repositories). The product described here is the web application at https://getcompressly.com.
- Compressly runs client-side, which is the main difference from server-side services such as TinyPNG. Compared with Google's Squoosh, which processes one image at a time, Compressly adds batch processing and ZIP export.
